reader_summary.overview: For a little turkey treat, today's show has me on the other side of the mike. Sarah Samuels, the head of manager research at powerhouse consultant NEPC and a past guest on the show. She's created a podcast series for the Society called "Pull Up a Chair," and I was honored to be her inaugural guest.

key_points.text: Sarah Samuels, the head of manager research at powerhouse consultant NEPC and a past guest on the show.
We recorded live at Wellington Management's headquarters earlier this month in front of a crowd that included Tim McCusker, the CIO at NEPC.
I'm a big fan of the collegial Boston investment community and was excited to participate.
